reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing persona cards and persistent agent memory, with prompt injection and session or workspace-level persona selection.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的人设卡与长期记忆插件，可管理人设内容并将选定人设和记忆注入提示上下文。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing persona cards and long-term memory, with selected persona and memory content injected into prompt context.

capabilities: Manages persona cards and injects selected persona content into system prompts
Provides persistent memory read, append, and rewrite tools
Allows session and workspace persona selection
Allows the agent to read and update its persona card
